title: Ventilation command
description: Request body the decision service sends via REST to an actuator process's command endpoint; also published to MQTT topic ventilation/<room_id>/command for other consumers (see project_notes.md §4).

room_id.description: Room identifier, matching BuildSim's room key.

level.description: Target ventilation level, normalized 0 (baseline) to 1 (full). Illustrative — the actual control range depends on the physical/actuator model, not yet finalized.
